'''Larellai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was present at the [[Royal Hunting Lodge]] on [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] shortly before the [[Battle of the Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR" />
